convert_coo_to_csr: convert COO format sparse indices to CSR format row offsets and column indices
convert_csr_to_coo: convert CSR format sparse indices back to uncompressed COO format row and column indices
transpose_sparse_matrix: transpose a sparse CSR matrix by computing new row indices, values, offsets, and column indices
convert_dense_to_sparse: convert a dense 2D matrix to sparse CSR format by extracting nonzero values and indices
convert_dense3d_to_sparse: convert a dense 3D batched matrix to sparse CSR format with consistent sparsity pattern across batch
